title: Zhuan Falun

ban_rows.note: The Chinese government banned Zhuan Falun and other Falun Gong publications on 24 July 1996 (US Department of Justice country report).

Foundational Falun Gong text (1995) by movement founder Li Hongzhi. Reportedly prohibited in Iran in 2008 as part of broader restrictions on minority religious movements. Source is OneWorld (Dutch HR magazine) compiling banned books across jurisdictions — not an Iranian primary source. Iran also bans Bahá'í texts and other minority-religion literature under the same doctrine.

Listed on Russia’s Federal List of Extremist Materials (Минюст) as entry #296. First published: 2006. Court decision: решение Первомайского районного суда города Краснодара от 27.10.2011.
